notes: Simple inline label. Colour via .color--{name} mixin. Icon props passed inside media object. Label renders via Text atom (default) or Heading atom (when level set or gradient text needed).

contentBadge.description: Badge display text. Pipeline content key.

colorTier._note: Tier values: tint=faintest, mid=softer, base=full saturation, emphasis=loudest. Applied uniformly across all variants. Implicit baseline is 'base' (set by .color--{name} mixin; no .color--tier-* class emitted). Omit to use.

gradientEmerge._description: Fade-in modifier — first 50% transparent, fades to solid. Combines with any gradient or solid colour.

gradientFade._description: Fade-out modifier — last 20% fades to transparent. Combines with any gradient or solid colour.

gradientFlip._description: Reverse gradient direction on text. Outline/glass: always available. Fill: only with emerge/fade.

fontFamily._description: Default: body via Text atom. When 'heading' is set, Text uses heading font. When level is set, Heading atom handles it.

fontWeight._note: Implicit baseline is 'bold' (no weight prop forwarded to nested Text/Heading; Badge CSS sets bold). Omit to use.

media._description: Nested atom node. Badge is the container — the child atom owns its own props (colour, weight, animation). `_lockProps`: child props deep-validated against the named atom's schema (B Move 2).

size._note: Implicit baseline is 'md' (no .badge--* size class emitted; CSS default sizing applies). Omit to use.

shadow._note: Implicit baseline is 'none' (no .badge--shadow-* class emitted). Omit to use.

borderWeight._note: Optional — when unset, badge renders without the explicit border-width override.

gradientAnimateDirection._description: Animation direction — clockwise, counter-clockwise, or sway.
gradientAnimateDirection._note: Implicit baseline is 'cw' (no [data-grad-anim-dir] attribute emitted). Omit to use.

gradientAnimateSpeed._description: Animation speed — slow (20s), default (12s), fast (6s). Gated by motion settings.
gradientAnimateSpeed._note: Implicit baseline is 'default' (no .gradient--speed-* class emitted). Omit to use.

gradientCycle._description: Colour cycle — cross-fades through the element's own tier tokens (tint→mid→base→emphasis).

altTextRule.description: When Badge is a sibling of Image inside any container, Badge.contentBadge is appended to Image.altWord by the pipeline.
